subject: LumenHealth procurement onboarding: MAP draft & Ariba/Coupa steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: LumenHealth procurement onboarding: MAP draft & Ariba/Coupa steps

Hi Erin — great to meet you and Tom earlier today. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on vendor onboarding (Ariba/Coupa + vendor forms) so your procurement team can see the milestones, owners, and blockers.

High-level recap from our discovery:
- Use case: Clinical summarization and patient outreach automation for pilot across 2 clinics (PHI controls required).
- Primary constraints: Vendor enrollment in Ariba; LumenHealth requires vendor W-9 + bank ACH details + SOC 2 chat.
- Target pilot start: mid-Feb (internal goal), target contract signature by 2027-02-28.

Attached: redwood_MAP_v1_LumenHealth.xlsx (draft MAP) and a blank W-9 template for your team to forward to Finance.

Draft MAP highlights (milestone / owner / target / dependency):
- Procurement intake completed / LumenHealth procurement / 2027-01-20 / internal review of SOW
- Vendor registration in Ariba / LumenHealth procurement & Redwood (Aditya) / 2027-01-27 / Ariba invite + vendor tax docs
- Contract signature (SOW + MSA) / LumenHealth Legal & Redwood Legal (Marissa) / 2027-02-14 / Redlines resolved
- KYC & bank setup (ACH) / LumenHealth Finance / 2027-02-18 / Completed W-9 + bank letter
- SOC 2 evidence exchange / Redwood Security (Aditya) / 2027-01-25 / NDA + evidence request list

As next steps I propose:
1) Erin — confirm who on procurement will own the Ariba vendor invite and the point email to receive the W-9.
2) Aditya — I’ve added you to the MAP to coordinate the Ariba triggers and security evidence.
3) Marissa — can you prepare a short redline timeline for Legal so we can hit the 2027-02-14 signature target?

If that looks right I’ll update the MAP and send a version for Tom + procurement distribution.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
redwood.com

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick items from procurement side:
- I will own the Ariba registration. Please send any vendor onboarding emails to procurement@lumenhealth.com and cc me.
- We need the completed vendor W-9 PDF and a bank ACH authorization letter for our finance team — I’ll confirm exact formatting by EOD Tues (2027-01-19).
- For SOC 2, we typically ask for a SOC 2 Type II summary and access to a TSC mapping. Can Aditya share the SOC 2 artifact checklist?

A question on timelines: if we open Ariba this week, what lead time would Redwood need before a go-live pilot?

Erin

Erin — thanks for the quick reply and for owning Ariba. Quick answers:
- Lead time: once vendor is active in Ariba and we have signed MSA + SOW, typical pilot provisioning (model access, test keys, and a secure demo environment) takes 7 business days. We build the environment concurrency-safe; if we start provisioning the week of 2027-02-01, pilot can begin by 2027-02-10.
- SOC 2 artifacts: Aditya, I’m looping you — can you share the SOC2 summary + TSC mapping checklist and an evidence request template to procurement@lumenhealth.com?

I updated the MAP with a dependency note on Ariba invite and attached the revised spreadsheet (redwood_MAP_v1_LumenHealth.xlsx v2). Marissa — any concerns on the legal timeline?

Hi Erin — looping in the Redwood security and vendor onboarding notes you asked for. Attached is: SOC2_Summary_Redwood_2026.pdf (summary), SOC2_TSC_mapping.xlsx, and an Evidence Request doc we usually send to procurement.

Quick checklist for your team to complete registration:
- Confirm point email for Ariba invite (procurement@lumenhealth.com confirmed)
- Completed W-9 (signed PDF) — I attached a filled example for formatting guidance (W-9_filled_example.pdf).
- ACH Authorization letter or voided check (PDF)
- Vendor contact for contract signature (Tom or Erin)

If LumenHealth can return the W-9 + ACH letter by 2027-01-27 we can accept an Ariba registration and aim to have vendor active by 2027-01-31, which preserves the 2/10 pilot target.

Sharing attachments now. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if procurement wants a quick walkthrough of the Ariba vendor flow.

Thanks — Aditya
